keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «시험 중에 시간을 멈추고 책을 보았다(실수)» 와 «정직한 노력이 어떤 마법 지름길보다 낫다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the mistake (Sora froze time during a test to look at her book) and the lesson (honest work is better than any magic shortcut). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Sora froze time to cheat on a test and take extra cookies.
Honest work is better than any magic shortcut.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why did Sora start to feel lonely?
opts: Nobody could talk to her while time was stopped.
Her friends were angry at her.
evs: At first, Sora loved her new power.
But soon she felt lonely, because nobody could talk to her.
Sora buried the watch back in the garden.
Sora found a strange silver watch in the school garden.
why: 시간이 멈추면 친구들이 조각상처럼 서 있어서 아무도 소라와 이야기할 수 없었어요. 친구들이 화났다는 말은 없어요.
When time stopped, her friends stood still, so nobody could talk to her. The text never says her friends were angry.

qs.q: Sora learned that "honest work is better than any magic shortcut." What is the "magic shortcut" in this story?
qs.qko: 소라는 "honest work is better than any magic shortcut"이라는 것을 배웠어요. 이 이야기에서 "magic shortcut"은 무엇인가요?
opts: using the watch to get things the easy, unfair way
a short road through the school garden
a fast way to run home
evs: She even froze time during a test to look at her book.
When she pressed the button, everything stopped.
Suddenly, the watch clicked, and time started moving.
Birds froze in the air, and her friends stood still like statues.
why: 소라는 시험 중에 시간을 멈추고 책을 봤어요. 이렇게 노력하지 않고 마법으로 쉽게 얻으려는 것이 «마법 지름길» 이에요. 진짜 길을 말하는 게 아니에요.
Sora froze time during a test to look at her book. Using magic to get things the easy, unfair way is the «magic shortcut». It is not a real road.

qs.q: Why did time start moving again?
opts: Sora said sorry and promised not to cheat again.
Sora's friends pressed the button for her.
Sora threw the watch into the garden.
evs: Sora began to cry. "I'm sorry," she said. "I will never cheat again."
She froze time to finish her homework and to take extra cookies.
Suddenly, the watch clicked, and time started moving.
Sora buried the watch back in the garden.
why: 소라가 울면서 «미안해, 다시는 속이지 않을게» 라고 약속하자, 바로 그때 시계가 딸깍 하고 시간이 다시 움직였어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
Sora cried and promised never to cheat again, and right then the watch clicked and time moved again. Put these two clues together.

ends: Another kid finds the silver watch in the school garden.
다른 아이가 학교 정원에서 은빛 시계를 발견해요.
Sora studies hard for her next test and does her best.
소라가 다음 시험을 위해 열심히 공부하고 최선을 다해요.

write.src: “I can’t <u>freeze time</u>, but I can <u>study a little every day</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «못 하는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can't do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «but I can» 뒤에 «동사 + 언제» 를 넣어 보세요. (예: but I can practice every day)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «but I can», write a verb + when. (e.g. but I can practice every day)

img.cover: In a sunny school garden, a girl with a short black bob and a red hairband in a navy school uniform with a yellow backpack holds up a shiny silver watch and grins, while three birds hang still in the air above her, a soccer ball floats in the middle of a kick, and her classmates stand frozen like statues in the middle of running and laughing.

scenes.1: In a classroom where every student sits frozen like a statue in the middle of a laugh, a girl with a short black bob and a red hairband in a navy school uniform with a yellow backpack tiptoes to the teacher's desk and sneaks three extra chocolate cookies from a big glass jar, holding a shiny silver watch in her other hand.
scenes.3: In the green school garden, a girl with a short black bob and a red hairband in a navy school uniform with a yellow backpack pats the soil over a small hole where a shiny silver watch is half buried, while birds fly again in the blue sky and her classmates run toward her, waving and smiling.

alt.1: Sora sneaks extra cookies while everyone is frozen.
alt.3: Sora buries the watch as her friends run to her.
